intro: BLEACH Festival fills HOTA through Sunday 11 October — free live music on the Lake Stage all week, with the spectacular High Tide closing night featuring jetpack performers above the lake and 100 giant jellyfish puppets descending on the parklands. Gold Coast Open House opens private buildings and landmark infrastructure free this coming weekend (10–11 October), and the Coolangatta Gold surf lifesaving endurance race draws the state's finest athletes to the beach on 17–18 October. Groundwater Country Music Festival then floods Broadbeach with 60+ free acts across three stages (16–18 October), before the Boost Mobile Gold Coast 500 street circuit takes over Surfers Paradise at month's end. The Pan Pacific Masters Games bring over 16,000 athletes from 30 countries to the Gold Coast for two weeks from 6 November.
topPicksTitle: Top Things To Do This Week (3–10 Oct)

topPicks.date: Final night — tonight, Saturday 3 October · HOTA Outdoor Stage
topPicks.name: Six60 at BLEACH — Last Chance Tonight
topPicks.desc: Last chance tonight — New Zealand's highest-selling live band headline HOTA's Outdoor Stage with Sub-Tribe in support. Roots, soul and dubstep under the stars as part of BLEACH Festival. $89 tickets, all ages, standing.

topPicks.name: 100 Keyboards by ASUNA
topPicks.desc: Final days for Japanese sound artist ASUNA's meditative installation — 100+ toy keyboards creating a shimmering wall of acoustic interference and imperfect tuning in HOTA Gallery 3. Deeply unusual; ages 16+.

topPicks.date: All week until 11 October · HOTA Lake Precinct
topPicks.name: BLEACH Live Music Stage — Free
topPicks.desc: Over 18 artists performing free all week on HOTA's Lake Stage as part of BLEACH Festival — Jerome Williams, Ella Fence, Karl S. Williams, Laurel Hill and more. No tickets, just walk up and enjoy.

topPicks.date: Saturday 10 – Sunday 11 October · Gold Coast citywide
topPicks.name: Gold Coast Open House — Free
topPicks.desc: A free weekend of architectural access — private homes, landmark infrastructure and award-winning public buildings open their doors. Palm Beach Aquatic Centre, Hinze Dam and the Desalination Plant among the highlights. Self-guided, city-wide.

events.name: BLEACH Festival 2026
events.desc: The Gold Coast's signature arts festival runs through 11 October — eleven days of free and ticketed live music, theatre, dance and large-scale spectacle at HOTA and across the city. Free family programming daily at the HOTA Lake Precinct.

events.date: Final night — Saturday 3 October · HOTA Outdoor Stage
events.name: Six60 at BLEACH Festival
events.desc: New Zealand's highest-selling live band bring their electrifying blend of roots, soul and dubstep to HOTA's Outdoor Stage tonight, with Sub-Tribe in support. An all-ages, all-standing show from 6 pm — $89 tickets.
events.location: HOTA Outdoor Stage, Surfers Paradise · 10 min drive

events.name: 100 Keyboards
events.desc: Japanese sound artist ASUNA fills HOTA Gallery 3 with over 100 toy keyboards — a meditative, shimmering wall of sound exploring acoustic interference, resonance and imperfect tuning. 1 hr 20 min, ages 16+.

events.name: This Moment — Dining at Palette
events.desc: HOTA's This Moment exhibition spills into Palette restaurant in its final days — art-inspired dining where the menu answers the gallery. A refined long lunch, ten minutes from the villa.

events.date: Closing night — Sunday 11 October · HOTA Lake
events.name: High Tide — BLEACH Closing Night
events.desc: BLEACH Festival's spectacular finale — jetpack performers taking flight above the HOTA Lake, 100 giant jellyfish puppets descending on the parklands and a family-friendly outdoor rave to close eleven days of creativity. A free sendoff not to be missed.

events.name: Gold Coast Open House
events.desc: A free weekend of architectural access — private homes, landmark infrastructure and award-winning public buildings open their doors. Highlights include Palm Beach Aquatic Centre, Hinze Dam tours and the Gold Coast Desalination Plant. Self-guided, city-wide.

events.name: Groundwater Country Music Festival
events.desc: Free three-day country music celebration across Broadbeach — Kasey Chambers, Kaylee Bell, The Wolfe Brothers and 60+ acts on outdoor stages. No tickets, no fuss, just great music in the sun.

events.name: Coolangatta Gold
events.desc: The Gold Coast's great surf lifesaving endurance race — the iconic 25.6 km course challenges the state's finest athletes across ocean swim, board paddle and beach run legs from Surfers Paradise to Coolangatta. Free to spectate from the sand.

events.name: Boost Mobile Gold Coast 500
events.desc: Surfers Paradise transforms into a world-class street circuit for Round 12 of the Repco Supercars Championship — 10 drivers in title contention, beachside grandstands and non-stop entertainment. Kids 12 and under free with a paying adult.
events.location: Surfers Paradise Street Circuit · 15 min drive

events.name: Pan Pacific Masters Games
events.desc: Over 16,000 athletes from 30+ countries compete across 42 sports in this massive biennial Masters Games — anchored at the Gold Coast Convention Centre in Broadbeach with competition spread citywide. Spectating is free at many venues across the Gold Coast.
events.location: Gold Coast Convention Centre, Broadbeach & citywide · 15 min drive
